news_cards.title: Bihar Me Hari Mirch Ki Kheti Par Subsidy: ₹24,000 tak anudan
bullets: Bihar sarkar dwara hari mirch ki kheti ke liye ₹24,000 tak anudan diya jayega: Kheti Vibhag, Bihar
Is yojana ke tahat ₹24,000 tak ka labh kisanon ko diya jayega: ₹24,000 tak anudan
Yeh anudan kisanon ko hari mirch ki kheti ke liye pratsahit karne ke liye diya jayega: Krishi Vikas ka uddeshya

news_cards.title: Bihar Me 2031 Me Honge National Games: Sarkar Ne Badli Khel Niti
bullets: Bihar sarkar dwara 2031 me national games aayojit kiye jayenge: Yuva Kalyan Vibhag, Bihar
Is yojana ke tahat ₹ ka nivesh kiya jayega: 2031 tak national games aayojit karne ka lakshya
Yeh khel niti ka uddeshya yuvaon ko khel ke kshetra me pratsahit karna hai: Khel Vikas ka uddeshya

news_cards.title: Bihar Sangrahalaya Sthapana Divas 2027 Par Antarashtriya Lok Kala Pradarshani
bullets: Bihar sarkar dwara Bihar sangrahalaya sthapana divas 2027 par antarashtriya lok kala pradarshani aayojit ki jayegi: Sanskriti Vibhag, Bihar
Is pradarshani ke tahat ₹ ka nivesh kiya jayega: 2027 tak pradarshani aayojit karne ka lakshya
Yeh pradarshani ka uddeshya Bihar ki sanskriti ko pratsahit karna hai: Sanskriti vikas ka uddeshya

news_cards.title: Desh Ki Pramukh Audyogik Samuhon Ke Saath MoU: Bihar Me 51600 Karod Rupye Ka Nivesh
bullets: Bihar sarkar dwara desh ki pramukh audyogik samuhon ke saath MoU kiya gaya hai: Udyog Vibhag, Bihar
Is MoU ke tahat ₹51600 karod rupye ka nivesh kiya jayega: 2027 tak nivesh karne ka lakshya
Yeh nivesh ka uddeshya Bihar ko steel hub banane ka hai: Udyog vikas ka uddeshya
